tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided square-root siphon to all seven observations with the full wide parameter bounds. The acquired probe resolves the pilot's narrow-gradient collinearity; fresh confirmation will test the resulting model.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The wide-gradient probe supplies the missing leverage for the three-parameter stationary siphon; the observations do not indicate a need for trajectory measurements.
The pilot is monotone concave, and the observed gradient dependence is not represented by the stated Haldane model.
The observed gradients are at or below 2.35, outside the specified supercritical gray zone.
